explanations.checks: The rule detects behavior the surface text hides (reflection, string references, undeclared effects) and records it as data with a confidence claim.

examples.after: userService.save()   # static reference the graph can prove

fixOptions.description: Declare the hidden behavior explicitly (rename to a static reference, declare the effect, bind the call) or accept the finding as recorded uncertainty.

explanations.rationale: It matters because these constructs are where AI-ported or reviewed code most often misses real behavior; surfacing them keeps the human in command of the invisible.
rootCauses: dynamic string-built references or reflective calls
side effects performed outside declared effects
framework conventions that imply behavior without declaring it

severityProfile.waiverPolicy: Waivers ride the closed waiver contracts; the finding and its confidence stay recorded.

targetNotes.note: Target-neutral: findings ride the semantic graph; adapters may add their own hidden-behavior evidence.

explanations.title: Hidden behavior surfaced as data
